name: Star-Eater Grooves
introDiscord: Smooth trails cut across the starstone where Star-Eater Slugs have slowly consumed anything luminous in their path. Shizuki called them 'cosmic lawnmowers.'
introTwitch: Smooth trails cut across the starstone where Star-Eater Slugs have slowly consumed anything luminous in their path. Shizuki called them 'cosmic lawnmowers.'

star-eater-grooves-approach.prompt: Three paths cross freshly gnawed starstone.

left.message: A cometglass seam survives inside a spot the Slugs somehow missed.

right.message: Shizuki's tonic reads: "Do not place glowing objects near slug. This includes Glimmer. Glimmer disagrees."
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the tonic and keep all glowing companions away from lawn maintenance.

forward.message:
A Star-Eater Slug slowly turns toward you.

Very slowly.

Menacingly slowly.

star-eater-grooves-depths.prompt: The grooves deepen into three smooth corridors.

left.message:
A Star-Eater Slug occupies the entire route.

It is not fast.

It is extremely committed.

right.message:
A Berry rests beside Shizuki's sign:

"COSMIC LAWNMOWER TEST:
Grass: unavailable.
Starstone: eaten.
Berry: ignored.
Useful findings."

forward.message: A star-chart coffer survived behind a ridge.

star-eater-grooves-threshold.prompt: Three enormous grooves converge on Gnawed Heavens.

left.message: A meteor-iron reliquary rests inside an untouched pocket.

right.message: A Slug slowly blocks your path with absolute confidence.

forward.message: Shizuki's bottle reads: "Emergency slug encounter supplies. Mostly for waiting."
forward.fullHpMessage:
"You leave it. The Slug is probably still approaching."

BOSS:

bossPromptDiscord:
The grooves ahead are enormous.

Something has been eating pieces of the constellation itself.

Use /yes to enter Gnawed Heavens or /no to allow the cosmic lawn service to continue unsupervised.
bossPromptTwitch:
The grooves ahead are enormous.

Something has been eating pieces of the constellation itself.

Use !yes to enter Gnawed Heavens or !no to allow the cosmic lawn service to continue unsupervised.
bossRetreatText: You retreat considerably faster than any Slug can object.

boss.revealText:
A colossal luminous Slug rises from the gnawed starstone.

Constellation Devourer reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Devourer retreats.

Several tiny Star-Eater Slugs immediately begin cleaning up the battlefield.

Efficient."
